answer: Hidden shadow-task checks stop Sybil attacks. First, the platform slips test jobs with known answers into the normal job stream, so fakes cannot tell them apart. Second, each agent must solve one shadow task weekly. Third, a wrong or copied answer costs a $40 fine and triggers a second test in a day. Fourth, two failures freeze the account and burn a $60 bond, results public. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real solves weekly plus $60,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is jade on a ledge, like a glacier carving a valley while a shop earns its queue one customer at a time.
